table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Item.Name,  
	aliasname=item.customicode, 
	active=CASE item.active WHEN 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,
	Item.purprice,   
	Item.PackUnits, 
	QTY = isnull(sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty),0),
	suppbalance=(select sum(debit - credit) from virtualgl where acccode=:ai_suppcode),
	supplier=(select name from accounts where acccode=:ai_suppcode),   
	classname=itemclass.name,
	Category=itemcategory.name,
	manufacturer=(select name from manufacturer where manfcode=max(item.manfcode)),
	UnitPrice = Case :ai_pricetype 
			WHEN 2 THEN Round(Item.purprice / Item.PackUnits, 2)
			WHEN 1 THEN Round(max(Item.Saleprice) / Item.PackUnits, 2)
			WHEN 3 THEN Round(max(Item.avgprice), 2)
		END ,
	PackQty =isnull( Round(sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty) / Item.packUnits, 2),0),
	StockValue = isnull(Sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty),0) *
		Case :ai_pricetype 
			WHEN 2 THEN Round(Item.purprice / Item.PackUnits, 2)
			WHEN 1 THEN Round(max(Item.Saleprice) / Item.PackUnits, 2)
			WHEN 3 THEN Round(max(Item.avgprice), 2)
		END
FROM 
	Item
	LEFT OUTER JOIN GodownDetail ON (Item.ICode = GodownDetail.ICode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN ItemClass ON (Item.iccode=itemclass.iccode),
	ItemCategory,
	suppliermanufacturers
WHERE 
	( Item.icatcode=itemcategory.icatcode) and
	(suppliermanufacturers.suppcode=:ai_suppcode) AND
	( Item.manfcode=suppliermanufacturers.manfcode)AND
	( Item.active=1)
GROUP BY 
	Item.name,
	item.customicode, 
	item.active,
	Item.purprice, 
	Item.PackUnits,
	itemcategory.name,
	Itemclass.name
